tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Harnack inequality on compact subdomains] 1. ch8:8.21\group ch08-generalized-solutions Under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.20, every $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $ satisfies \begin{equation} \sup _{\Omega '}u\leq C\inf _{\Omega '}u, \tag {8.64} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\Lambda /\lambda ,\nu ,\Omega ',\Omega )$.
Proof

\sketch Join points of $\Omega '$ by a finite chain of interior balls and iterate Theorem 8.20.

□
